mechanism: A catchable signal between background runner spawn and _WATTSON_RUNNER_PID assignment invokes cleanup with no registered runner. The shell can exit143 while the orphan runner and its separate log-command session retain captured pipes, so communicate cannot receive EOF.
fix: Defer catchable signal exit only during background spawn/PID publication in all three runner entrypoints, then immediately replay the first pending status. Reset deferral state before cleanup commands.
